decisions.reason: The cover Requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the 5.5 x 8.5 trim size, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The trim-size decision does not resolve the outstanding question about whether the title page should include an image or otherwise change its content requirements.
The selected trim size does not change the copyright page's publisher-line requirement.
The existing rule that table-of-contents page numbers are updated after book size is finalized remains valid unchanged; the source does not establish a new numbering or TOC rule.
Although trim size may inform later image formatting, the source trim-size change does not necessarily alter the current illustration selection, coverage, placement, or review requirements.
The trim-size decision does not change the Chapter 12 subtitle hierarchy, line roles, or capitalization requirements.
The trim-size decision does not affect the prohibition on the unintended literal newline artifact in the book title.
The selected trim size does not change the required back-matter content or author copy.
The paperback trim-size decision does not change the manuscript editing goal or the approved passages.
